title: I Took the Apartment Package-Room Camera to the Neighbor Who Swore

parts.text: My box vanished from the package room at 2:14 p.m. according to the delivery photo. The neighbor on two, Lila, swore she had not seen it. I was twenty-six. The super said cameras were dummy globes. I asked the management portal for the real clip anyway. They sent a still: Lila in a yellow coat tucking my box under a stroller. I printed the still. Then Lila posted in the building chat that people should not order things if they cannot watch the lobby.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: She is lecturing the chat with my box still under her stroller in the still.

social.video_title: The dummy globe caught the yellow coat — Part 1/2
social.description: Delivery photo, dummy cameras that were not dummy, a stroller. Then a lecture. Would you have knocked first?

parts.text: I knocked with the still. Lila said it was a mistake and she was holding it safe. Safe is a text, not a stroller. She gave the box back. I posted RETURNED in the chat without her name, then emailed the still to management because dummy globes need budgets. They labeled the cameras real in the next notice. I opened the box. It was cat litter. I would have lent the litter. I will not lend a lie.

social.video_title: She returned the litter she had been keeping safe — Part 2/2
social.description: No names in chat, cameras relabeled, litter at home. Was a stroller a locker?
